en: Tinted vintage postcard view of a riverside harbor scene. Several sailing boats are moored along the left bank, while a grassy peninsula with a masonry embankment juts into the water. On the peninsula stand a few light‑colored buildings with red roofs and a tall chimney in the background, suggesting industrial or abattoir facilities. A man in a long dark coat and hat stands in the foreground near the water. The image is framed in an oval on a light background, with printed captions in pink and publisher information along the left margin.
